first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A black-and-gray long gun that sways with the viewpoint along the bottom edge of the frame; in the final frame, only part of the front end and front sight is visible.

entities.name: damp, debris-strewn corridor floor
entities.identification: The dark floor extending into the distance between the walls on both sides, with reflections from standing water and debris on it.

entities.name: peeling two-tone corridor wall
entities.identification: The corridor walls on both sides, light-colored above and dark-colored below, with a conspicuous irregular peeling area on the right.

entities.name: light-colored narrow windowed door on the right wall
entities.identification: The dirty, worn, light beige door nearby on the right wall; a vertical narrow window is visible in the early portion, while only the left part of the door panel is visible in the final frame.

entities.name: group of wooden pallets on the right
entities.identification: The group of brown pallets beside the door on the right wall; one leans diagonally against the wall, while another lies flat on the floor to its left.

entities.name: open doorway at the far end of the corridor
entities.identification: The rectangular doorway in the distance along the corridor; a dark door panel on the left obscures part of the entrance, while the remaining opening reveals a brighter space.

entities.name: square wall light at the far end
entities.identification: The small, bright white wall light on the wall above and to the left of the far doorway; its illuminated face is a nearly square rectangle.

entities.name: damaged suspended ceiling
entities.identification: The light gray paneled suspended ceiling above, with openings from missing panels and bent, drooping panel pieces.

entities.name: exposed corridor piping
entities.identification: Long pipes of varying thicknesses along the ceiling and upper right wall, including thick gray and rust-red pipes and thin pipes that turn along the wall.

entities.name: hanging corridor cables
entities.identification: Thin black lines along the upper right wall and near the damaged ceiling in the distance, including a nearby long, narrow U-shaped hanging section.

entities.name: window on the left
entities.identification: The bright window partially visible at the far left in the first frame, most of which is outside the frame.

entities.name: gray radiator below the window
entities.identification: The gray multi-section heating fixture partially visible below the window on the left.

entities.name: scattered corridor debris
entities.identification: Light gray broken panels, long thin strips, and irregular fragments on the floor, densely concentrated nearby and in front of the doorway.

entities.name: standing water on the corridor floor
entities.identification: Irregular areas of standing water on the dark floor, with elongated and fragmented bright patches.
